title: delphinium consolida var. pubescens
intro: Delphinium consolida var. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy larkspur, is a plant species belonging to the family Papaveraceae. Hairy larkspur is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antispasmodic, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of hairy larkspur include alkaloids, such as delphinine and ajacine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
